## Annotaton via Funannotate
Retrieve the software container environment from Dokcer Hub
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
pull image from docker
#1. create a coda environment for the tool
#2. activate the environment
conda activate _squali
#3. Add necessayry bioinformatics chnnels, if they are not already configured
conda config --add channels config 
conda confif --add channels bioconda
conda config --add channels conda-forge
#4. Install sequali from bioconda channel
conda install-y bioconda::sequali
```
